---
title: "Caveat and Limitation"
author: "Yun Jiang"
---

## caveat

1. M: Cron `c9bc25a4` fires at 17:59, not 18:00 — the scheduler's fixed
   early offset for one-shots pinned to :00.
2. M: If Claude Code is closed at 17:59, the durable one-shot does not
   run then; it surfaces for catch-up at the next launch.
3. M: cs-derived metrics count a supplementary/secondary record only when
   that record carries the `cs` tag — an aligner-dependent input property,
   not guaranteed by the format.
4. L: QC-fail (0x200) and duplicate (0x400) records are also included in
   every metric; no filter for them exists in the codebase.
5. M: "Never decided" in the record-universe audits means no recorded
   decision — the attribution rests on absent filters and commit
   messages; unrecorded deliberation cannot be ruled out.
6. M: the 2026-11-18 secondary-exclusion agreement is design-level; the
   numeric impact on existing datasets was not measured (no BAM scanned
   this turn, and per user instruction pipeline data was not consulted).
7. M: 0.9.0 outputs shrink wherever secondary records exist — do not mix
   0.8.x and 0.9.x outputs in cross-version comparisons.
8. L: annotate output BAMs from 0.9.0 carry no tags on secondary records
   (0.8.x tagged them) — downstream tag filters see a behavioral change.

## limitation

1. M: This turn scheduled the analysis only; it did not itself examine
   whether error-stats metrics include supplementary records.
2. M: The 2026-11-16 record-universe audit is static code reading plus
   existing test assertions; no new BAM fixture was run this turn.
3. L: The downstream ecsngsqc workflow's interpretation of these columns
   was not audited.
4. L: The provenance trace stops at this repo's scaffold (c0a80c4);
   cs-tagger, the pre-port ancestor, has no history here.
